adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `teamDestinationCalendars` is mutated via `teamDestinationCalendars.push(...)` inside the async `map` callback that builds `teamMemberPromises`. The later logic (`await Promise.all(teamMemberPromises);` then `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`) implicitly relies on those side effects having happened. While it likely works today (the push occurs before the first `await` in the callback), it is fragile/temporally coupled and could break if an `await` is introduced before the push or the sequencing changes.
